title: Digital Revolution Must De-Bureaucratize Mexico’s Social Security Institute, Sheinbaum Says
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Alma E.
Muñoz](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz)
originally appeared in the [October 22, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/22/politica/revolucion-
digital-debe-desburocratizar-al-imss-sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left wing
daily newspaper._

To address the legitimate demands of the workers of the Mexican Social
Security Institute (IMSS), that institution must carry out a “digital
revolution” similar to the one being carried out at IMSS-Bienestar. The
objective is to streamline procedures and de-bureaucratize processes for the
benefit of staff and beneficiaries, said President Claudia Sheinbaum. However,
she stressed, this transformation will require **the collaboration of the
workers ' union**.

During her press conference, hours before IMSS director Zoé Robledo announced
the new salary increase proposal for the institute's staff, the President
explained that for one week work was done to identify areas of opportunity
where the agency could make adjustments to obtain savings that will make it
possible to offer workers **a larger salary increase**.

> Beyond the propaganda they have tried to make out of all this, there are
> other demands of IMSS workers that are legitimate and that have to be
> addressed, such as having the necessary materials at the time of performing
> a surgical operation.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

Addressing the conflict with IMSS workers, the President highlighted that
intense work was done to offer a new proposal.

She stressed that **substantial adjustments must be made to the IMSS 's
operational processes**, because there are inertias that come “from a very
long time ago –they are not Zoe's–, that should not be,” since what matters is
an institutional functioning that makes it possible to improve working
conditions for doctors, nursing staff and ultimately the service for
beneficiaries.

Sheinbaum insisted that to address the current situation, **a comprehensive
proposal for the modernization** of the agency will be promoted.
